title: Parts Relay: car part numbers from a plate, answered on WhatsApp
tagline: Original and aftermarket car parts from a plate or a VIN.

cover.label: A short manual for the parts counter
cover.title: A plate comes in. The right part numbers go out.
cover.text: Your workshops write on WhatsApp with a plate and the part they need. Parts Relay identifies the vehicle, finds the original part numbers with their aftermarket matches, and answers in the chat. Your counter follows every request in one queue.

write.title: The workshop writes
write.text: A plate and the part needed, as a text, a photo or a voice message, sent to the Parts Relay number on WhatsApp.

identify.title: The vehicle is identified
identify.text: From the registration plate or the VIN, Parts Relay finds the exact vehicle before it looks for any part.

find.title: The original parts are found
find.text: It picks the right catalog category and reads the original part numbers, with the exploded view and each position.

answer.title: The answer goes back
answer.text: Original numbers and aftermarket matches arrive in the chat, and the request lands in your search queue.

replies.title: Requests answer themselves
replies.text: A workshop writes, confirms with one word and gets the part numbers in the chat. Nobody at the counter retypes the plate.

vehicle.title: The vehicle comes first
vehicle.text: Parts Relay identifies the exact vehicle from the plate or the VIN before it looks for any part, so the numbers belong to that car.

queue.title: One queue for everything
queue.text: Requests from WhatsApp and searches from your team share one list, with the vehicle, the status and who asked.

install.title: Nothing to install
install.text: Your workshops keep using WhatsApp, with no account to create. Only the numbers you enable can search.

costs.text: Two things cost a parts counter: the minutes spent looking up each request, and the wrong parts that come back. Put in your own numbers and read the sum.

install.question: Do workshops need to install anything?
install.answer: No. They send a WhatsApp message to the Parts Relay number with a plate and the part they need, as a text, a photo or a voice message.

who.question: Who can search?
who.answer: The WhatsApp numbers you add as contacts, and your team from the web app. Any other number gets a reply asking them to contact you.

web.question: Can we search without WhatsApp?
web.answer: Yes. Anyone in your team starts a search from the web app with a registration plate or a VIN, and the result joins the same queue.

languages.question: Which languages does it speak?
languages.answer: The web app and the WhatsApp replies are available in English and Italian.

fitment.question: Are the results a fitment guarantee?
fitment.answer: No. Results are identification guidance. Always confirm vehicle fitment before purchase.
